description: The conformance rules every profile inherits. A suite drives them in this order. Profiles add rules beside these and never remove one. Every rule must have a scripted defect in the profile's test suite that makes exactly that rule fire.

rules.expectation: The manifest's command starts the plugin and its stdout accepts a request.
The handshake names a protocolVersion the host speaks; anything else is refused before any other method is called.
The handshake response is an instance of the committed envelope schema, profile fields included.
A request whose method is not in the profile receives a -32601 frame carrying the request's id, and the connection continues.
A malformed line receives a -32700 frame rather than silence, and the next well-formed request is still answered.
After every other rule has been driven, the plugin is still running and still answers handshake.
